words: I had some ideas that I wanna can I just pass to you and you move up? On the OWASP, what would be cool is to actually have a design that actually shows one of the designs should be the old wiki. So because it was quite a cool wiki for OWASP. I think it was based on MediaWiki, so we could actually recreate that. And for example, OWASP London, we should actually go back to the previous versions and even find as much information and who spoke there, what presentations what happened, the videos, all the kind of stats and information are really cool, including a lot of the messages that were initially on the mailing list. Basically do a really great job. Actually, I think that deserves a whole team just working on that. Again, that's a good example of the power of what we can do, right? And again, we want to move that to Angelo account, which is, I think that was the plan.
decision: An idea from Dinis to pass up, not yet a build order. For the OWASP sites: one of the designs recreates the old OWASP wiki look (MediaWiki based). For OWASP London: go back through previous versions and gather as much as possible (who spoke, the presentations, what happened, the videos, stats, and early mailing-list messages), done really well, by a whole team. The work belongs on Angelo's account, which Dinis believes was the plan. The maestros confirm which account that is and who starts the team; nothing starts until that is settled.
care: Public history only. Speakers' names and talks as published; no email addresses or private details from mailing-list archives; each item cites its source.

accounts: the account Dinis calls Angelo's (to be confirmed)
